info.title: Scrinly Browser API
info.description: Public screenshot, region, Visual Style Guide, visual diff, monitoring, batch, job-status, and usage API.

post.description: Resize, crop and re-encode a screenshot you already captured — no recapture, no AI. Pick a `preset` or set `width` / `height` / `format`, and optionally cut a `region` or `bounds` first. One credit per output; verified cache hits are refunded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An unexpired screenshotId belonging to the authenticated account.

422.description: All outputs failed, with settled credits

503.description: Infrastructure unavailable; ambiguous settlement supplies a polling job ID rather than claiming a refund

get.description: The same single-output transform as POST, described entirely in the query string — handy for `` tags and quick tests. `cache` defaults to **true** here so re-fetching a link reuses the stored output instead of charging again. `outputs`, `webhookSecret` and storage credentials are POST-only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An unexpired screenshotId belonging to the authenticated account.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Named output shape: og-image, twitter-card, thumbnail, square, full-width.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Cut this saved region (e.g. `region-1`) from the screenshot. Requires a capture with `regions=true`.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: With `region`: part id or index (`0` = first).

parameters.name: savedCrop
parameters.description: With `region` + `part`: use the stored crop file instead of cutting original pixels. Use it for pages whose whole screenshot exceeds 64 MP or 24 MiB.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width. Give one side to keep the aspect ratio.

parameters.name: fit
parameters.description: How to fit both sides: `contain` may pad, `cover` may crop, `fill` may stretch. Default `contain`.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Padding / transparency fill for `contain` and JPEG.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output encoding. Default: same family as the source.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Reuse an identical stored output (refunded). Defaults to true on GET.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Return 202 and a status URL instead of waiting.

parameters.name: webhookUrl
parameters.description: Deliver the result here; implies async.

get.description:
Returns JPEG or PNG bytes unless storage, regions, asynchronous delivery, or Visual Style Guide requires a JSON result.

Every option that fits in a URL is available here. These are **POST-body only** and are refused with `400` in a query string, because URLs are recorded in logs, browser history and caches: `headers`, `cookies`, `webhookSecret`, and customer-storage credentials (`storage_access_key_id`, `storage_secret_access_key`, `storage_application_key_id`, `storage_application_key`). Customer-storage destinations (`storage_provider`, `storage_bucket`, `storage_endpoint`, `storage_region`, `storage_public_domain`) need those credentials, so use POST for them too.

post.description: Accepts up to 100 URLs. Public batches are screenshot-only and reserve one credit per accepted item.

patch.summary: Update, pause, or resume a monitor

post.summary: Replace a fixed or rolling baseline

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use token from the verification email.

Device.name: device
Device.description: Server-supported device preset; overrides width and height.

WaitUntil.name: waitUntil
WaitUntil.description: Navigation readiness strategy. Network-idle modes are opt-in for pages that eventually become quiet.

Regions.name: regions
Regions.description: Adds ordered full-page crops and two credits; implies full-page storage.

StyleGuide.name: styleGuide
StyleGuide.description: Adds a GPT-5.6 Luna Visual Style Guide; implies regions and stored full-page capture.

Regenerate.name: regenerate
Regenerate.description: Bypasses only the seven-day Style Guide cache. Requires styleGuide=true.

ProviderApiKey.name: X-Scrinly-Provider-API-Key
ProviderApiKey.description: Ephemeral OpenAI BYOK for Visual Style Guide. Server-to-server and synchronous only.

BlockCookieBanners.name: blockCookieBanners
BlockCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie-consent banners before capture.

BlockAds.name: blockAds
BlockAds.description: Block common ad networks and hide ad slots.

BlockChatWidgets.name: blockChatWidgets
BlockChatWidgets.description: Hide third-party chat and support widgets.

HideSelectors.name: hideSelectors
HideSelectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to hide before capture, e.g. `.promo,#chat`. Commas inside `()`, `[]` or quotes do not split. The POST body takes an array.

ClickSelectors.name: clickSelectors
ClickSelectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to click, in order, before capture. Same splitting rules as `hideSelectors`.

ScrollToElement.name: scrollToElement
ScrollToElement.description: CSS selector to scroll into view before capture.

Design.name: design
Design.description: Add raw observed design evidence (colors, fonts, spacing) to the JSON result. One credit.

WebhookUrl.name: webhookUrl
WebhookUrl.description: Deliver the result to this URL; implies `async=true`. Send `webhookSecret` in a POST body to sign deliveries.

StorageReturnLocation.name: storage_return_location
StorageReturnLocation.description: Include the provider location of the stored object in `media`.

StorageUrl.description: Direct URL for the complete stored output.

CreditsUsed.description: Credits used in the current allowance after settlement.

ScreenshotSuccess.description: Binary or JSON screenshot result. JSON may be partial when an add-on failed.

PlanRestricted.description: Plan does not allow the requested monitor capacity or cadence

CaptureFailed.description: Complete finite screenshot could not be produced

NavigationTimeout.description: Page navigation exceeded the requested timeout; the complete charge is refunded and the failure is retryable.

DiffFailed.description: Source integrity or diff processing failed; credit refunded

Unavailable.description: Required platform configuration or provider unavailable

region.description: Cut this saved region (e.g. `region-1`) from the screenshot. Requires a capture with `regions=true`.

part.description: With `region`: one part of it, by id (`region-1-part-0`) or index (`0` = first). Original screenshot pixels.

savedCrop.description: With `region` + `part`: use the stored crop file instead of cutting original pixels. Use it for pages whose whole screenshot exceeds 64 MP or 24 MiB.

bounds.description: Cut an arbitrary rectangle. Cannot be combined with `region`.

width.description: Output width. Give one side to keep the aspect ratio.

fit.description: How to fit both sides: `contain` may pad, `cover` may crop, `fill` may stretch. Default `contain`.

background.description: Padding / transparency fill for `contain` and JPEG.

format.description: Output encoding. Default: same family as the source.

TransformOutputSpec.description: One output: optionally what to cut (`region` / `part` / `bounds`), then its size and encoding. No selector = the whole screenshot; no size = re-encode only.

TransformRequest.description: Describe one output at the top level, or several in `outputs`. With `outputs`, top-level fields are defaults for every output; an output that says what to cut replaces the default `region`/`bounds`.

fit.description: How to fit both sides: `contain` may pad, `cover` may crop, `fill` may stretch. Default `contain`.

outputs.description: Several outputs in one job, one credit each. Each is a preset name or an object; top-level fields apply to all. Returns ordered `results`.

url.description: Direct B2, S3, or R2 URL.

executedPlan.description: Ordered crop/resize and optional encoding. Format may occur once, last. Otherwise retain source format, lossy quality 80.

device.description: Server-supported preset; overrides width and height.

regenerate.description: Requires Style Guide; bypasses only its AI cache.

url.description: Direct B2, S3, or R2 URL.

version.description: New captures return regions-v2. Saved v1 manifests remain valid diff inputs, including mixed-version comparisons.

segmentationDegraded.description: True when unresolved geometry fallback was needed. Included in new v2 captures; absent from historical v1 manifests.

screenshotId.description: Opaque account-owned reference for newly completed stored captures. Historical results may omit it; no public lookup route is provided.

referenceExpiresAt.description: Original reference expiry. Cache hits do not renew it; expiry does not delete the delivered image.

emailMasked.description: Safe masked address; plaintext addresses are encrypted at rest.

TransformPreset.description:
Named output shape. Explicit fields override it.

| preset | size | fit | format |
|---|---|---|---|
| `og-image` | 1200 × 630 | cover | webp 80 |
| `twitter-card` | 1200 × 600 | cover | webp 80 |
| `thumbnail` | 400 wide | contain | webp 75 |
| `square` | 1080 × 1080 | cover | jpeg 85 |
| `full-width` | 1920 wide | contain | webp 80 |

On a whole full-page screenshot, the fixed-shape presets (`og-image`, `twitter-card`, `square`) take the **top** of the page at their aspect ratio. Set `region`, `bounds` or `fit` to choose differently.
